steps.title: Prepare extraction buffer (large batch)
steps.instruction: In a 50 mL conical tube add 50 g guanidine isothiocyanate, 5.3 mL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 5.5 mL 0.2 M EDTA, 10.6 mL 20 % Sarkosyl, 1 mL β‑mercaptoethanol, then bring the volume to 50 mL with ddH₂O. If using 0.5 M EDTA, add 2.2 mL 0.5 M EDTA (the remaining volume is water) to obtain a final 0.2 M EDTA concentration.

steps.title: Alternative buffer prep for few samples
steps.instruction: For each sample prepare 200 µL buffer by mixing 0.2 g guanidine isothiocyanate, 21.2 µL 1 M Tris‑HCl pH 7.5, 22 µL 0.2 M EDTA (or 8.8 µL 0.5 M EDTA), 42.4 µL 20 % Sarkosyl, 4 µL β‑mercaptoethanol, and add ddH₂O to a final volume of 200 µL. Scale up (e.g., 10‑sample batch: 2 g guanidine, 212 µL Tris, 220 µL EDTA, 424 µL Sarkosyl, 40 µL β‑mercaptoethanol, 2 mL ddH₂O).

steps.title: Resuspend silica magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Vortex or pipette G‑Biosciences silica magnetic beads thoroughly to obtain a uniform suspension.

steps.title: Aliquot beads per sample
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of the bead suspension into each labeled 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube (e.g., 160 µL for 8 samples). Up to 15 samples can be prepared in a single tube, but larger volumes increase drying time.

steps.title: Add extraction buffer to tissue
steps.instruction: Place the tissue sample in a 1.5 mL tube and add 200 µL of the prepared extraction buffer.

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a hot plate at 55 °C overnight.

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove debris (if needed)
steps.instruction: If solid debris remains, centrifuge the lysate for 2 min at 12 000 rpm (temperature as required). Perform all lysate handling in a fume hood.

steps.title: Combine lysate with beads
steps.instruction: Add ~200 µL of the cleared extraction lysate (liquid only) to the tube containing 20 µL of silica beads. Discard any residual debris.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL 100 % ethanol, gently mix, and incubate on a rotary mixer for 15 min.

steps.title: Magnetic separation after ethanol
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a magnetic stand for ~5 min (until the solution is clear) and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: First PE buffer wash
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Qiagen PE Buffer, incubate on a rotary mixer for 10 min, then place on the magnetic stand for ~5 min and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat PE washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the PE Buffer addition, 10‑min rotary incubation, magnetic separation, and supernatant removal two additional times (total of three PE washes). Briefly spin the tubes in a mini‑centrifuge before the final magnetic step to collect beads in the caps.

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: While the tubes remain on the magnetic stand, allow the beads to air‑dry for 20–45 min.

steps.title: First water wash (100 µL)
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL ddH₂O (or, if appropriate, Elution Buffer 10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0 – not for museum samples), resuspend the beads by pipetting or vortexing, place on the magnetic stand for 30–60 s, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Repeat water washes
steps.instruction: Repeat the 100 µL ddH₂O wash and magnetic separation two more times (total of three 100 µL washes).

steps.title: Final low‑volume wash
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL ddH₂O (scaled: 160 µL for 8 samples) to the beads, resuspend briefly.

steps.title: Elute nucleic acids
steps.instruction: Add 20–50 µL ddH₂O to the beads, gently mix, and incubate at 55 °C for 10 min.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: If needed, briefly spin the tubes, place on the magnetic stand until clear, transfer the supernatant (eluate) to a clean, labeled tube, and discard the beads.

steps.title: Optional bead‑mixture aliquoting
steps.instruction: If preparing bead mixtures in bulk, aliquot ~26.3 µL of the bead suspension per sample (or ~20 µL per tube for 8 samples) into labeled 1.5 mL tubes before adding lysate.
